name: Lily C. Sherbet
original_name: リリィ・C・シャーベット
source:
Lily Caramel Sherbet was the original leader of the Rune Angel Troupe. She pilots the Emblem Frame Eagle Gazer.

Serious and attentive, Lily is a strong young woman. A trained swordswoman from the planet Celdar, she nearly always carries her sword with her, even on vacation. She is a strong believer in teamwork and works hard to make sure the Rune Angel Troupe functions as a smooth unit. She occasionally expresses approval of group activities with, "That's good training." She also sometimes uses English words during conversation (e.g. when she was stuck in a costume, she cried out, "Mayday! Mayday! Emergency da!"). She is also known for her tendency to express approval with "OK-da" and disapproval with "NG-da" (NG standing for No Good). 

She is very loyal, and a strong believer in protocol (as she addresses other characters by name and rank as much as possible). She is also somewhat naive when it comes to certain aspects of social interaction due to her training. For example, she wears the skimpiest swimsuit of the Rune Angels because it offers her the most ease of movement.
 
Lily is also a perfectionist. If she fails at a task will keep trying at it until she succeeds.

[Edited from [url=http://galaxyangel.wikia.com/wiki/Lily_C._Sherbet]Galaxy Angel Wiki[/url]]
